label: The actual CONCRETE_6 roster is inhabited and every member has an actual CONCRETE_6 ground
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (motivated by metaphysical infinitism and coherentism about dependence): some concrete candidate exists at w, and every concrete candidate existing at w has a concrete ground existing at w under the selected relation at w. It does not say whether the grounding descends without end or runs in a circle, and says nothing about non-concrete or absent grounds.
